why: Real shape from PR #198, fixed by #305 (issue #304): currentLabelKeys reads listIssueLabels for page 1 only and its result is then used as the complete set — counted for the per-PR label budget and searched with contains — so on a PR with more labels than one page holds the reconciler undercounts and re-applies labels past max-labels, with no error. The bot caught this on itself in #198. Dimension 6 (pagination) is the block that asks for the page walk; with dimension routing on, this case fails if a source batch with a REST list call stops carrying it.
prTitle: feat(review): keep re-reviews from pushing a PR past max-labels
prDescription: Counts the labels already on the PR against REVIEW_LABELS_MAX so repeated reviews do not keep adding labels.
